point: Core team established for the project
details: A core group of team members identified, with some flexibility for others to join based on availability

point: Data quality issues from multiple sources
details: Reporting data comes from multiple sources with varying quality; some SSIS jobs are outdated and not ideal for CDP consumption

point: Raw data preferred over manipulated data
details: Preference to consume raw data from SSIS processes rather than end results to allow selective use of data pieces

point: Guice is a reporting engine, not a long-term priority
details: Guice functions like Power BI for drag-and-drop report building; not critical for long-term roadmap and alternatives are being explored

point: Guice has technical limitations with joins
details: Guice cannot perform joins across multiple data sources; data must be joined at SQL level in DWRPT before presenting to Guice
Common Client ID implemented to improve table joins; discovered data cleanliness issues
Reports generated in Guice are used for client-facing purposes; built by internal product team (primarily Jacob), non-technical users
Data organized by application schemas (e.g., SL for Social Logic, ML for MediaLogic) to prevent data conflation

point: Guice embedded via iframe with security controls
details: Guice reports embedded in company portal using iframe with login requirements and specific security rules

point: Power BI available but resource constraints
details: Power BI available but lack of internal Power BI developers; offshore team utilized to avoid taking engineering resources
